laws.rule: Tourism Dirham fee per occupied room per night, for up to 30 consecutive nights: AED 20 at five-star hotels, AED 15 at four-star, AED 10 at two- and three-star and AED 7 at one-star. Hotel apartments and holiday homes pay matching tiers. Hotels must show it on prices and invoices.
laws.heading: Administrative Resolution No. 2 of 2020

laws.rule: Dubai Airports lists drones as a controlled item for travellers, with the Dubai Civil Aviation Authority (DCAA) as the controlling authority, and says the permits must be obtained before arrival in Dubai. Drones must also be declared on arrival through the iDeclare app. The federal rules for recreational drones (registration and approved zones) are held at country level.
laws.heading: Arrivals prohibited items

laws.rule: Dubai Executive Council Resolution 3/2026 replaces the public-transport violations schedule. It lists smoking and carrying alcoholic beverages inside public transport or its facilities as violations. This is not just a ban on drinking alcohol: the schedule separately lists carrying it.

Dubai public transport: the 2026 violations schedule requires the applicable fare and a valid personal fare card, with the card presented on request. It lists using someone else's, expired, invalid or counterfeit cards as violations.

Dubai public-transport facilities: follow posted RTA instructions and designated passenger areas. The 2026 schedule lists spitting, littering, putting feet on seats, eating or drinking in prohibited areas, and sleeping in passenger shelters or wherever sleeping is prohibited as violations. Animals are barred except guide dogs accompanying blind people. Safety and security devices, including emergency exits, are for cases of necessity.

items.text: Dubai public transport and its facilities: smoking is a violation under replacement Schedule 3, item 11, Executive Council Resolution 3/2026. This record does not assess other tobacco or vaping rules.

Carrying alcoholic beverages inside Dubai public transport or its facilities is a listed violation under replacement Schedule 3, item 13, Executive Council Resolution 3/2026. Do not read this as permission to carry alcohol elsewhere or as a review of emirate purchase and consumption rules.

psychoactive-substances.notes: Emirate public-transport rule only. Other state substance rules, exemptions and municipal levels not yet checked. Fine amounts are not reproduced here.
